notes: Kublai Khan ruled as emperor of the Yuan dynasty (1271).
The Golden Horde, Chagatai Khanate and Ilkhanate acted as independent states; Rus princes paid tribute to the Golden Horde.
The Deccan was ruled by the Yadavas, Kakatiyas and Hoysalas; Delhi did not yet hold Gujarat, Malwa or Rajasthan.
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.
Korea was ruled by Goryeo (a Yuan vassal from 1270) until 1392 and by Joseon after; it no longer shows as part of the Yuan.
The Blemmyes disappear from the record by the 7th century; their land is the Beja.
Teotihuacan (abandoned about 550), Monte Albán (about 850) and Classic Veracruz are replaced by the peoples of this date.
Borneo and the Philippines were part of "Hindu kingdoms of central India"; they are the minor Hindu and Buddhist kingdoms.
